title: Does cpaic's two-stage component bridge fail under its assumptions' violations only as known mechanisms predict?
question: When a disconnected component network is bridged by a shared component, does the cross-gap contrast from cpaic's cSTC bridge degrade under synergy, drift of effect modification across subnetworks, a misdeclared target mean and poor overlap exactly as the linear pass-through of each edge's bias predicts, or does something component-specific appear?
design: Five-trial disconnected component network bridged by a shared component, all trials with individual data; cpaic's cSTC edges (sourced at commit cf27b1a) and unadjusted edges bridged by netmeta::discomb, one departure at a time at matched severity plus null, no-modification and combined cells. 10 cells, 1000 replicates each.
